## Ruled-out approaches: each approach that was tried and ruled out, with the reason, so it is not retried.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: made stuck jobs invisible for hours.
- Tenant-less rebuild scans: caused excessive sequential scans and incorrect cross-tenant processing.
- Per-document embedding clients: unnecessarily duplicated client setup.
- Independent vector upsert transactions: inefficient; use bulk transaction.
